tagline: 玛米亚旁轴相机，1959 年发布
description: 玛米亚于1959年推出的旁轴相机。配备** Mamiya-Sekor T 48mm f/2.8 (3 elements in 3 groups)。快门速度Copal SVK leaf shutter with self-timer, B + 1 - 1/500。使用Lever (175 degrees)。

specs.镜头: ** Mamiya-Sekor T 48mm f/2.8 (3 elements in 3 groups)
specs.取景器: Reverse Galilean viewfinder, automatic parallax correction
specs.快门: Copal SVK leaf shutter with self-timer, B + 1 - 1/500
specs.曝光测光: Built-in selenium meter with coupled match needle (visible on top only)
specs.英文简介: The Mamiya Ruby is a leaf-shutter fixed-lens rangefinder introduced by Mamiya starting in September 1959.
